claims.text: Many reviewers say the gel effectively reduces tooth sensitivity, especially after whitening treatments.
Some reviewers report the product did not help their sensitivity or even irritated their gums.
Several reviewers note the product does not include trays, so users need to supply their own.
A few reviewers complain about the gel's consistency or dispenser, describing it as watery or difficult to use.
Some reviewers mention a pleasant minty taste.
